Perfect for Dinner At Da Nang
Jun 2026 • Couples
If you had to choose just one restaurant to return to Da Nang after many years, I’d recommend Dom 34 Phan Bội Châu.

Its European-inspired style is gentle and understated. What I like most is how consistently excellent the food has remained over the years—it brings back memories and a deep sense of longing for Da Nang. There’s a feeling that’s hard to describe: ordering the same dish that I had enjoyed three years ago with my family. Now, the flavors are still intact, and they bring me so many emotions.

The space is warm, cozy, and impeccably neat and clean. The staff are friendly, which makes everything feel even more familiar. And the prices here are genuinely great for the quality of the food. If you’re traveling to Da Nang with friends, a partner, or family—and you want a pleasant place to eat that isn’t overly complicated, yet still meets high-end standards, with prices that are surprisingly affordable—then come here and give it a try at least once.

A place to chill and enjoy delicious food with friends
Jul 2024 • Friends
I just had a wonderful experience at Dom Bistro, an outstanding restaurant in Da Nang. The first impression upon entering is the unique space, a harmonious blend of bar and restaurant styles that creates an atmosphere that is both cozy and vibrant. This is truly an ideal place to relax after a long day. And I was also quite surprised to see many Korean customers here, as it seems to be a popular spot that Koreans always choose to experience in Da Nang.

In terms of cuisine, Dom Bistro leaves a strong impression with its diverse menu, ranging from fresh seafood to exquisitely prepared beef and chicken dishes. Each dish carries distinctive flavors and characteristics, making it difficult for me to pick a favorite. Notably, the prices are very reasonable considering the quality of the food, making the dining experience even more enjoyable.

What I truly appreciate here is the enthusiasm and friendliness of the staff. They not only serve well but also understand and cater to customer needs very effectively, like true local friends. The staff is always ready to offer suggestions and create the most comfortable atmosphere for diners.

In conclusion, Dom Bistro is not just a place to enjoy delicious food but also a complete experience in terms of service style and ambiance. I will surely return and recommend this wonderful spot to my friends!

May 2024 • Couples
When people think of Vietnamese western food, they think of French first, but this Italian Bristol in Da Nang is not to be missed.
Antony, the manager, brings his experience in managing high-end hotels to the restaurant, taking care of the time it takes to serve food and what customers want.

French bistro where you can enjoy food and wine
Jul 2023 • Solo
Wherever I go abroad, I always go to a French restaurant.
This time, I went to DOM for dinner, which had received high reviews from customers.
In Southeast Asia, I have avoided eating live animals as much as possible, but I was curious to try oysters from Miyagi Prefecture. They were delicious!
For the main course, I ordered anjo, and the quality of the meat, the doneness (they asked me how I wanted it cooked), and the seasoning were all very good, so I was very satisfied.
I wanted white wine with the oysters and red wine with the anjo, so I ordered each by the glass, and both the white and red wines were delicious. The air conditioning was working well (many places aren't), and the dining atmosphere was calm and homey, just like a bistro! Highly recommended!
